volume_quiet.title: Volume wizard (1/3): quietest level
volume_quiet.description:
Use the remote or the volume knob to set the **quietest** level you actually use. It becomes 0 % on the slider.

Current receiver volume: **{current}**

Select Submit when ready. The wizard only reads the volume and never changes it.

volume_loud.title: Volume wizard (2/3): loudest level
volume_loud.description:
Quietest level saved: **{quiet}**.

Now set the **loudest** level Home Assistant should use. It becomes 100 % on the slider.

Current receiver volume: **{current}**

Turn the volume down again afterwards if needed, then select Submit.

volume_limits.title: Volume wizard (3/3): limits
volume_limits.description:
Slider range: **{quiet}** (0 %) to **{loud}** (100 %).

The maximum volume is a hard limit for the slider and volume up. It is preselected with your loudest level.

data_description.max_volume_raw: Home Assistant never raises the volume above this level.
data_description.volume_step_db: How far one volume up/down press moves the receiver.
